title: Ilioara Residence: reviews and 6 real differences
seoTitle: Ilioara Residence: reviews and 6 real differences
description: Ilioara Residence reviews: underfloor heating included, 4 apartments per floor, a closed street in Titan, direct from the developer. Why it is different.
descriptionLlm: Ilioara Residence is a new building in the Titan-Dristor area, Sector 3 Bucharest (Aleea Eprubetei 7-11), with ground floor plus 8 storeys (2 penthouses sold on the top floor) and 31 apartments for sale, 4 per floor. Differentiators: underfloor heating included in the price, a closed street set back among houses, a direct sale from the developer with no commission for the buyer, completion December 2026. 2 room apartments 107,500-136,500 EUR + VAT, 3 room apartments 151,000-168,000 EUR + VAT.
keywords: Ilioara Residence reviews, why Ilioara Residence, the difference between Titan apartments, new apartments Titan, apartments Dristor Sector 3, underfloor heating included, apartments direct from the developer Bucharest, new building Titan completion 2026, Aleea Eprubetei
lead: Almost every new building in Titan tells the same story: close to the metro, modern finishes, a safe investment. On paper they all sound alike, which is exactly why real opinions about one particular building are hard to find, people compare renders, not differences. Ilioara Residence does not need adjectives to stand out. It has six concrete things that other new buildings in the area either do not put in, or sell to you separately. And it has one more we say from the start: it is not ready today. It is completed in December 2026, so you buy before you see it finished. Below we take them one by one, with a verdict on each.

sections.h2: The underfloor heating is in the price, not on the options list

blocks.x: This is where the first real difference shows. Many new buildings show you a nice price per square metre, then the underfloor heating turns up as an extra, as an upgrade you pay for separately if you want it. At Ilioara Residence it is included. Everywhere in the apartment. And on the balcony, which almost nobody does.

The difference is not about comfort, it is about money. When an option is already in the price, the displayed price is the real price, not the starting point of a discussion. You pay what you see, not what gets added along the way.

sections.h2: A closed street, set back among houses, not a boulevard

blocks.x: Most new buildings boast about the footfall. Next to the big artery, next to the traffic, next to everything. It sounds good in the listing. It sounds bad at three in the morning, with the window open in summer.

Ilioara Residence sits on Aleea Eprubetei, a closed street, set back among houses. You have the Titan-Dristor area a few steps away, but you do not live in the middle of it. Nicolae Grigorescu metro at 5 minutes on foot, the Ilioara bus stop at 3 minutes, trams 19, 23 and 27 at 4 minutes. Everything you need is close, and the boulevard noise is not. That does not show in a render. You feel it after you move in.

sections.h2: Four apartments per floor, not ten

blocks.x: Density says more than the entrance hall. A building with ten doors on the landing means a lift always in use, neighbours you never get to know, a constant coming and going you hear through the walls.

At Ilioara Residence there are four apartments per floor: one with 3 rooms and three with 2 rooms. A short landing, few doors, quiet. In total 31 apartments for sale on ground floor plus 8 storeys, plus 2 penthouses already sold at the top: a building that does not feel like an anthill. The layout is modular, the total areas run from 49 to 86 sqm. Fewer neighbours per floor is not a marketing detail. It is what an ordinary day at home looks like.

sections.h2: Direct from the developer, 0% commission for the buyer

blocks.x: This one is simple and easy to check. The apartments are sold directly by the developer, with no commission for the buyer. The displayed price is the price you pay, not the price plus a percentage that turns up at the end.

The prices are always written with "+ VAT", so there are no surprises: 2 room apartments between 107,500 and 136,500 EUR + VAT, 3 room apartments between 151,000 and 168,000 EUR + VAT. The reservation is 2,000 EUR + VAT, the minimum deposit 30%. Parking, if you want it, comes separately: a Klauss double with two spaces stacked at 25,000 EUR + VAT, a single one at 20,000 EUR + VAT, or renting from 80 EUR + VAT a month for the first 3 clients. We write all of it openly, because transparency convinces more than any argument.

sections.h2: What is left is up high, where the view is

blocks.x: Here there is both good news and a truth we do not hide. Out of 33 apartments, 12 are still available. The lower floors have almost sold out, not completely, but almost. Most of those left are up on floors 6 and 7, the part with the best view.

It sounds like luck, but it is logical: whoever came first took what was lower down, and now whoever comes catches exactly the part many people look for at the end and no longer find. The upper floors, the ones you look for when you want light and a view that does not change overnight because someone builds a block in front of you.

sections.h2: It is off plan, completion December 2026, and we say it straight

blocks.x: The part other sellers walk around. Ilioara Residence is not ready now. It is completed in December 2026, so if you buy, you buy before completion. This is not for everyone. Anyone who wants the key tomorrow is in the wrong place.

What you get in exchange for the wait is concrete: underfloor heating included, triple glazed Salamander joinery with 7 chambers, a 24 kW Ariston boiler of your own, today's price locked in with a deposit, and the chance to choose among the upper apartments while they are still there. Anyone who buys off plan with their head does not buy a promise, they buy a better position than the one at the end. Here that position still exists, but out of 12 apartments they get sold, they do not multiply.
In detail: what to check in a newly built block.

faq.q: What should I make of Ilioara Residence compared with other new buildings in Titan?
faq.a: There are five concrete differences: underfloor heating included in the price (everywhere, plus on the balcony), a closed street set back among houses instead of a boulevard, only 4 apartments per floor, a direct sale from the developer with no commission for the buyer, and the apartments left are up on floors 6 and 7, the ones with the view. The point of honesty: it is off plan, with completion in December 2026.

faq.q: Why Ilioara Residence and not a building that is already finished?
faq.a: Because if you can wait until December 2026, you catch today's price, you choose among the upper floors while they are still available (12 apartments out of 33 are left) and you pay a price in which the underfloor heating is already included, not added at the end. If you want the key straight away, a finished building is your choice, not this one.

faq.q: What does an apartment at Ilioara Residence cost?
faq.a: The 2 room apartments are between 107,500 and 136,500 EUR + VAT, and the 3 room ones between 151,000 and 168,000 EUR + VAT. The total areas run from 49 to 86 sqm. The reservation is 2,000 EUR + VAT, and the minimum deposit 30%.

faq.q: Do I really pay no commission?
faq.a: No. The sale is made directly by the developer, with 0% commission for the buyer. The displayed price is the price you pay, with no percentage added at the end.

faq.q: Where exactly is it and how close is the metro?
faq.a: On Aleea Eprubetei 7-11, the Titan-Dristor area, Sector 3, on a closed street. On foot from the door of the building: Nicolae Grigorescu metro 5 minutes, the Ilioara bus stop 3 minutes, trams 19/23/27 at 4 minutes, Mega Image and Piața Mihail Ambrozie 6-7 minutes, IOR Park 9 minutes.
Separately from the apartment. A Klauss double space, with two spaces stacked, at 25,000 EUR + VAT; a single space at 20,000 EUR + VAT; or renting from 80 EUR + VAT a month for the first 3 clients.

faq.q: How do I find out which apartments are still free?
faq.a: There are 12 apartments still available out of 33, most of them on floors 6 and 7. For the up to date list and a look at the floor plans, write on WhatsApp.
